reported_symptom: Crossing state intermittently switches between Occupato/Libero and Sconosciuto on multiple clients.
changes: Vision owns occupancy fields; controller rendering no longer resets them to unknown on each telemetry poll.
A brief web gap retains the last server-confirmed crossing and waiting counts for up to 2 seconds since metadata reception.
A browser observation older than 750 ms is explicitly labeled Ultimo dato ricevuto with delayed update.
Server-reported stale observations, invalid tracking and prolonged web gaps bypass retention.
MCU protocol and watchdog remain unchanged.

regressions: Both clear and occupied states are retained and labeled during a brief web gap.
Server-reported staleness immediately makes occupancy unknown.
Invalid unknown tracking does not reuse a previous valid crossing state.
A prolonged web gap makes occupancy unknown.
Controller rendering does not reset crossing or vision/analytics counts.

limit: The trace observed a short replay segment. Group-client behavior must still be checked after all clients reload.
